pages.title: Causal Shielding Plate
pages.text: A plate of chronosteel and causal shield lattice that keeps cause and effect in the right order on either side. It feels slightly ahead of the moment, as though it knew I was going to touch it. Its surface is faintly lined.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Time machines can leak effects before their causes. I layered a causal shield lattice on chronosteel and chronoplastic casing, and the plate kept the order straight.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Plasma Metallurgy.
